game_title: Max Finder Derby – Lantern Path Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Path, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the herbalist ahead. Then check the best value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the mushroom ring by solving code steps involving best that move the herbalist forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the mushroom ring first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Max Finder Derby' (Week 5 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Lantern Path'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how best changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Lantern Path.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
